text:
Kyle Palmieri grew up in Smithtown, a few exits from where the Islanders play, and at 35 he's back in a top-six role because of injuries up front. Over the last five games he has moved in beside Casey Cizikas and Simon Holmstrom and is up to about 17:50 a night. The results haven't come yet: three goals and five points in 16 games.

Our numbers flag him as due. He's at three goals on 5.4 expected, and the team has scored about five fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. He's getting the looks; Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking (a small sample) has him on the end of a lot of passes across the slot and from behind the net, the kind that go in about a quarter of the time.

He played only 25 games last season, and Evolving-Hockey's read on those 472 minutes was around replacement level against tough competition. Treat that loosely. Our range has him somewhere between 15 and 30 goals over a full season. If the chances keep coming, the goals usually follow.
headline: Palmieri is due
